claims.statement: For every nonnegative measurable kernel K on R^n, the supremum of integral K prod_i f_i over independent probability densities 0<=f_i<=1 equals the supremum over f_i=1_{E_i} with |E_i|=1. In particular qform small-ball extremals reduce exactly to arbitrary measure-one product sets.
claims.scope: All finite n; no moment, support, centering, continuity or symmetry assumptions.

claims.statement: If every target-admissible Q and every product E_1 x ... x E_n with |E_i|=1 satisfy |{x in product: Q(x) in J}| <= C |J| for every interval J, then every admissible independent bounded-density input has output density <=C a.e.
claims.scope: Essential-supremum density conclusion; continuity is not supplied.

claims.statement: If A=U Lambda U^T has rank exactly 3, U^T U=I_3, |lambda_j|>=1, and every coordinate leverage |u_i|^2<=1/2, then |phi_Q(t)|<=min(1,(pi e/|t|)^(3/2)) and ||p_Q||_infinity<=3e for arbitrary independent input densities bounded by 1; all signatures are allowed.
The flat rank-three projector obstruction in fleet02/B15, with row leverage 3/n, satisfies ||p_Q||_infinity<=3e for n>=6. The same holds for its signed diag(1,1,-1) rank-three analogue.

claims.unpaid: Handle localized leverage max_i |u_i|^2>1/2 and, for general A, incorporate all remaining spectral directions without treating their dependent contribution as an independent convolution.
